text: Gomɗii Men halkiino mofte adinooɓe on, onon ɓee sirkooɓe, fii ko ɓe yeddirnoo Nulaaɓe Alla ɓen, ɓe faggitii geddi. Nulaaɓe Maɓɓe ɓen ɓe Men Nuli e maɓɓe addani ɓe hujjaaji ɓannguɗi, tinndinɗi goonga ko ɓe addi kon immorde e Joomi maɓɓe. Ɓe wonaano gomɗinooɓe, tawde ɓe heblanaaki liimanaku. Alla jaasini ɓe, O ronkiɓe hawrindirde e peewal. Ko wano Men yoɓitirnoo ɗen mofte tooñuɓe, Men yoɓitirta nanndo mon'en e kala jamaanu e nokku.
